subject: Reprice request: Veridian competitive match + fallthrough plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@veridian.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridian.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Can Redwood match CloudForge pricing for inference spend?

Hi Markus,

Quick note from procurement — CloudForge has provided a commercial counteroffer we need to evaluate. Summary:
- Estimated 12-month usage: ~180M tokens/month (text gen + embeddings) + 3 dedicated vGPU endpoints for 100 RPS burst
- CloudForge proposed: 28% off list for a 12-month committed spend + 60k onboarding credit

We like Redwood's runtime and observability, but we need price parity to proceed. Can you confirm whether Redwood can match the pricing or propose an equivalent package? Important gating items:
- SOC 2 evidence and architecture diagram for private deployment
- Migration timeline (minimal downtime)
- Any egress or hidden costs for embedding use

Attaching CloudForge quote for context.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Infrastructure
Veridian AI

Attachments: CloudForge_quote_Q345.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@veridian.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Can Redwood match CloudForge pricing for inference spend?

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the quote.

Short answer: we can put together a structured match that preserves unit economics while protecting runtime SLAs. High-level options (short bullets so procurement can pick):

1) 12-month commit (preferred)
   - 25% off our current hosted rates across generation + embeddings
   - $50k onboarding credit (applied over first two invoices)
   - Dedicated burst pool included (3 vGPU) with 99.9% uptime SLA

2) 6-month pilot + conversion
   - 20% off for pilot months; $80k migration credit if converted within 90 days
   - Limited dedicated capacity during pilot (soft guarantee)

3) Cost-first dedicated offer
   - Reserved capacity pricing that approximates CloudForge list after quantization/packing recommendations
   - Migration engineering days at discounted hourly rate

Caveats / tech calls:
- To get to CloudForge parity we will recommend L2 quantization for your large embedding model; this can impact initial quality and requires an eval prompt suite.
- KV caching and prefix reuse can materially lower per-token costs; we should collect early traffic traces.

I've attached a short internal match framework and a migration checklist. I'm going to loop in Marissa (sales ops) for commercial packaging and Connor for runtime compatibility / migration delta.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick 30-min commercial sync (this week)
- Technical deep-dive (Connor) with sample traffic (one hour)

Can your team do Thurs or Fri this week for the commercial sync?

— Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Veridian_match_framework.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@veridian.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Can Redwood match CloudForge pricing for inference spend? -- pricing breakdown

Elena — looping in sales ops details and a clearer packaging proposal.

Pricing summary (baseline for negotiation):
- Option A (12m commit): 25% off list; $50k onboarding credit; 2% rebate based on +10% overcommit usage
- Option B (6m pilot -> convert): 20% off pilot, $80k credit on conversion
- Add-on: Private deployment (VPC) + KMS integration: one-time setup fee $12k

Operational fallthrough plan (important):
- If we hit capacity constraints, requests will auto-failover to a compatible model tier (slightly higher latency). We will guarantee data isolation and logs for audit.
- We propose a migration SLA in contract appendix: 8 weeks to full production for standard connector stacks; 12 weeks for bespoke on-prem setups.

Attachments: pricing_breakdown.xlsx, fallthrough_policy.md

Connor — pls prep a short checklist for the tech call (runtime compat, quantization risk, egress breakdown).

Elena — happy to run a 30-min commercial sync Thursday 10/22 09:00 PT or Friday 10/23 11:00 PT. Which works for you?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@veridian.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridian.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Can Redwood match CloudForge pricing for inference spend? -- pricing breakdown

Marissa — thanks, the team reviewed the options and we are prepared to proceed on Option A (12m commit) with a few asks:

- We accept 25% off list and $50k onboarding credit contingent on a DocuSign SOW that includes the 8-week migration SLA and the private VPC + KMS setup as an add-on.
- Need express language on the fallthrough plan in the contract appendix: specifically, a performance delta not to exceed 150ms p50 for the fallback model and transparent cost accounting for any fallthrough traffic.
- Please send the DocuSign link and HubSpot deal ID reference (we'll cross-check with procurement). Our procurement contact: procurement@veridian.ai

HubSpot Deal ID: HS-95734

If we can get the signatures within 30 days, we will start the migration hold and allocate the dev resources.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Infrastructure
Veridian AI
